trait_augments._note: Heart=Silver(+1 trait count), Crest=Gold(emblem item), Crown=Prismatic(emblem+strong bonus). Impact: 1=minor flex, 2=notable upgrade, 3=forces comp pivot, 4=win-condition defining.

_categories.emblem: Grants a trait emblem item Ã¢ÂÂ equip on a unit to give them the trait. Changes unit slot math.
_categories.heart: Counts as +1 unit of that trait without an emblem. Frees a unit slot.
_categories.combat_boost: Directly amplifies the trait's combat stats Ã¢ÂÂ damage, healing, shields, shred.
_categories.econ_boost: Grants gold, XP, or item generation tied to activating the trait.
_categories.utility: Provides non-combat utility Ã¢ÂÂ CC uptime, AS, positioning effects.
_categories.scaling: Trait bonus scales harder the more units you stack Ã¢ÂÂ rewards going deep.

Heart.effect: +1 N.O.V.A. count. Allows 5-piece NOVA one unit earlier.
Heart.decision_note: Lets you run 5 NOVA at lv7 instead of lv8. Opens flex slot for Nunu/Maokai early.
Heart.pivot_threshold: Take if you have 3+ NOVA units already.

Crest.effect: NOVA emblem item. Equip on any unit to grant N.O.V.A. trait.
Crest.decision_note: Equip on Maokai for heal strike, or Shen for shred. Enables 5 NOVA without a 5-cost. Best-in-slot for NOVA vertical.
Crest.pivot_threshold: Always commit to NOVA vertical if you take this.

Crown.effect: NOVA emblem + all NOVA strikes deal 15% bonus true damage.
Crown.decision_note: True damage modifier makes NOVA unkiteable. Hard commit to 5+ NOVA. Pair with Aatrox shred for 45%+ true damage chain.
Crown.pivot_threshold: Force 5 NOVA. Level to hit 5 NOVA by stage 3.

Heart.effect: +1 Meeple count. Speeds up Meeple 3 threshold.
Heart.decision_note: Allows Meeple 3 with one fewer unit. Useful for fast 8 boards.
Heart.pivot_threshold: Take if running 2+ Meeple units.

Crest.effect: Meeple emblem. Any unit becomes a Meeple.
Crest.decision_note: Best on Bard or Corki to reach Meeple 4 without Veigar. Significant board flexibility.
Crest.pivot_threshold: Commit to Meeple 4. Reconsider comp direction entirely.

Crown.effect: Meeple emblem + all Meeple units deal 20% more ability damage.
Crown.decision_note: Transforms AP Meeple carries. Veigar/Bard with this Crown becomes a late-game threat. Force Meeple 5 if possible.
Crown.pivot_threshold: Hard commit Meeple AP. Build Veigar/Bard items immediately.

Heart.effect: +1 Vanguard count. Enables Vanguard 4 one unit earlier.
Heart.decision_note: AP Vanguards core stabilizer. Allows Vanguard 4 at lv6 instead of needing lv7.
Heart.pivot_threshold: Take if you have 3 Vanguard units and are playing AP Vanguards.

Crest.effect: Vanguard emblem. Any unit becomes a Vanguard.
Crest.decision_note: Best on LeBlanc or Karma Ã¢ÂÂ gives them Vanguard HP/shield synergy without replacing a frontliner.
Crest.pivot_threshold: Force Vanguard 4. Strong stabilization.

Crown.effect: Vanguard emblem + Vanguard units gain 30% bonus armor and magic resistance.
Crown.decision_note: Makes Vanguard frontline unkillable. LeBlanc survives much longer behind immortal tanks. Best-in-slot for AP Vanguards.
Crown.pivot_threshold: Force Vanguard 6 if possible. Frontline becomes endgame-viable.

Heart.effect: +1 Conduit count. Conduit synergy: each Conduit unit generates bonus gold per PvP win.
Heart.decision_note: Econ trait Ã¢ÂÂ extra gold generation accelerates item/level timing. Strong with Conduit Reroll.
Heart.pivot_threshold: Take if econ augment is your path. Pairs with Rich Get Richer.

Crest.effect: Conduit emblem + additional gold per combat.
Crest.decision_note: Enables fast 9 path from econ snowball. Best on Viktor or Miss Fortune.
Crest.pivot_threshold: Lean into Conduit reroll if you have MF/Ornn early.

Crown.effect: Conduit emblem + +3g per win, Conduit units gain 15% damage.
Crown.decision_note: Win-condition defining. Enables rolling while maintaining 50g. Conduit Reroll becomes the strongest possible comp with this.
Crown.pivot_threshold: Hard commit Conduit Reroll. Level 7 slowroll above 50g.

Heart.effect: +1 Rogue count. Rogues deal bonus execute damage below threshold.
Heart.decision_note: Enables Rogue 4 without an emblem. Fizz/Kai'Sa execute power increases.
Heart.pivot_threshold: Take if running 3 Rogue units.

Crest.effect: Rogue emblem. Best on non-Rogue flex to reach 4-piece.
Crest.decision_note: Equip on Karma for utility Rogue, or Maokai for tanky Rogue. Frees a unit slot for stronger flex.
Crest.pivot_threshold: Commit to Rogue 4. Roll at lv7 above 30g.

Crown.effect: Rogue emblem + Rogue units deal 25% more damage to targets below 40% HP.
Crown.decision_note: Execute amplifier. Fizz 3-star + Crown = near-instant kills on wounded targets. Force Rogue 4-5.
Crown.pivot_threshold: Hard commit Rogue reroll. Fizz/KaiSa become priority reroll targets.

Heart.effect: +1 Redeemer count. Redeemer: MF/Rhaast gain stacking damage on kills.
Heart.decision_note: Stacking damage amplifier. Useful in Redeemer or Conduit comps with MF.
Heart.pivot_threshold: Take if you have MF + Rhaast already.

Crest.effect: Redeemer emblem. Enables Redeemer 4 without full unit set.
Crest.decision_note: Best on Maokai/Ornn to stack Redeemer bonuses on frontline kills. Enables faster MF/Rhaast stacking.
Crest.pivot_threshold: Commit to Redeemer vertical.

Crown.effect: Redeemer emblem + stacking bonus doubled, max stacks increased.
Crown.decision_note: MF becomes hyperscaling late-game. Needs to reach late rounds Ã¢ÂÂ HP management critical.
Crown.pivot_threshold: Force Redeemer 4. Play for late game stack payoff.

Heart.effect: +1 Bastion count. Bastion: frontline tanks gain stacking armor/MR.
Heart.decision_note: Frontline durability. Accelerates Bastion 4 breakpoint for Aatrox/Shen boards.
Heart.pivot_threshold: Take if Aatrox is on your board.

Crest.effect: Bastion emblem. Best on Nunu or Rammus to reach Bastion 4.
Crest.decision_note: Enables Bastion 4 without running all 4 Bastion units. Allows flex spot.
Crest.pivot_threshold: Take if you need Bastion 4 for comp stability.

Crown.effect: Bastion emblem + Bastion stacks have no cap. Tanks scale infinitely.
Crown.decision_note: Late-game frontline becomes unkillable. Best when game goes long (6+ stages).
Crown.pivot_threshold: Force Bastion 4. Tanks become true win-condition.

Heart.effect: +1 Fateweaver count. Fateweaver: units gain mana on attacks.
Heart.decision_note: Faster spell cycling for AP carries. Relevant for Caitlyn/TF boards.
Heart.pivot_threshold: Take if 2+ Fateweaver units on board.

Crest.effect: Fateweaver emblem. Enables Fateweaver 4 mana breakpoint faster.
Crest.decision_note: Faster Caitlyn/Twisted Fate spell cycling. Moderate power bump.
Crest.pivot_threshold: Take if you are committed to Fateweaver board.

Crown.effect: Fateweaver emblem + Fateweaver units gain 20% crit chance.
Crown.decision_note: Crit synergy on TF/Caitlyn is strong. Combines well with Jeweled Gauntlet.
Crown.pivot_threshold: Build JG on TF/Caitlyn immediately. Force Fateweaver 4.

Heart.effect: +1 Stargazer count. Stargazer: constellation hex buffs apply to +1 unit.
Heart.decision_note: Extends constellation hex coverage. Relevant when playing hexes that buff your carry.
Heart.pivot_threshold: Take if Xayah or Riven is your carry and hex placement is favorable.

Crest.effect: Stargazer emblem. Opens constellation hex slots on any unit.
Crest.decision_note: Flexible emblem. Best on Riven or Nunu to maximize hex positioning.
Crest.pivot_threshold: Commit to Stargazer vertical and optimize hex placement.

Crown.effect: Stargazer emblem + constellation hexes provide +25% stronger buffs.
Crown.decision_note: Amplifies carry hex bonuses. Xayah on a buffed hex with this Crown becomes S-tier late carry.
Crown.pivot_threshold: Force Stargazer 4. Optimize hex placement every round.

Heart.effect: +1 Psionic count. Psionic: units gain bonus ability power per cast.
Heart.decision_note: AP scaling amplifier. Sona/Fiora boards benefit most.
Heart.pivot_threshold: Take if Sona or Viktor is your carry.

Crest.effect: Psionic emblem. Best on high-cast AP carry.
Crest.decision_note: Viktor with Psionic emblem becomes dual-trait carry with massive AP stacking.
Crest.pivot_threshold: Build Nashors+JG on Viktor immediately.

Crown.effect: Psionic emblem + Psionic AP stacks persist between rounds.
Crown.decision_note: Viktor/Sona snowball each round. Win-condition if game goes to stage 5+. Play for late game Ã¢ÂÂ avoid early loss streaks.
Crown.pivot_threshold: Hard commit AP Psionic. Win streak or survive to late game.

Heart.effect: +1 Dark Star count. Dark Star: Jhin/Mordekaiser gain stacking AD/AP on kills.
Heart.decision_note: Kill-stacking amplifier for Jhin. Late game Jhin numbers become absurd with stacks.
Heart.pivot_threshold: Take if Jhin is your carry.

Crest.effect: Dark Star emblem. Enables Dark Star 4 for extra kill-stack rate.
Crest.decision_note: Dark Star 4 doubles kill-stacking speed. Jhin snowballs in 2-3 kills.
Crest.pivot_threshold: Force Dark Star 4. Jhin BiS: IE+GS+LW.

Crown.effect: Dark Star emblem + kill stacks are permanent (survive round end).
Crown.decision_note: Jhin becomes game-winning carry by stage 5. Every kill compounds. Play for late game stacking Ã¢ÂÂ avoid dying early.
Crown.pivot_threshold: Build Jhin items from stage 2. Every kill matters.

Heart.effect: +1 Mecha count. Mecha: Mighty Mech gains stacking stats from ally deaths.
Heart.decision_note: Mighty Mech scales faster. Useful for Mecha fast 9.
Heart.pivot_threshold: Take if Mighty Mech is on your board.

Crest.effect: Mecha emblem. Any unit becomes Mecha.
Crest.decision_note: Best on Aurelion Sol to give Mighty Mech scaling to a carry. Very strong combo.
Crest.pivot_threshold: Commit Mecha vertical. Level 9 for full cap board.

Crown.effect: Mecha emblem + Mighty Mech gains 2x stats from ally deaths.
Crown.decision_note: Mighty Mech becomes unkillable by mid-game if allies die first. Position Mighty Mech backrow initially, rotate forward as stacks accumulate.
Crown.positioning_note: Start Mighty Mech row 2, move to row 4 after 3+ ally deaths
Crown.pivot_threshold: Hard commit Mecha. Mighty Mech is your frontline AND win-condition.

Heart.effect: +1 Space Groove count. Space Groove: all allies gain attack speed and regen.
Heart.decision_note: Global attack speed boost. Relevant for AS carries like Xayah or Bel'Veth.
Heart.pivot_threshold: Take if you have 3+ Space Groove units.

Crest.effect: Space Groove emblem. Extends groove buff to additional unit.
Crest.decision_note: Moderate power. Best on Nami or Shen.
Crest.pivot_threshold: Only take if already committed to Space Groove.

Crown.effect: Space Groove emblem + groove effect grants 40% more AS and regen.
Crown.decision_note: Nami with this Crown becomes a strong late-game AP + utility unit. Space Groove becomes a real comp direction.
Crown.pivot_threshold: Force Space Groove 4. Nami items: JG+Morello+AA.

Heart.effect: +1 Brawler count. Brawler: melee units gain bonus max HP.
Heart.decision_note: Minor frontline HP boost. Niche value in Maokai/Gragas boards.
Heart.pivot_threshold: Low priority. Only take if nothing else is relevant.

Crest.effect: Brawler emblem. Gives any melee unit Brawler trait bonus HP.
Crest.decision_note: Frontline durability. Niche Ã¢ÂÂ not a comp-defining augment.
Crest.pivot_threshold: Only take if it fills an immediate survival need.

Crown.effect: Brawler emblem + Brawlers gain bonus damage scaling with max HP.
Crown.decision_note: HP-scaling damage on Maokai or Gragas. Interesting with Warmog+Sunfire builds.
Crown.pivot_threshold: Take if Maokai/Gragas are your frontline AND you have Warmogs.

Heart.effect: +1 Timebreaker count. Timebreaker: slow enemies on ability cast.
Heart.decision_note: CC utility. Weak unless running full Timebreaker vertical.
Heart.pivot_threshold: Low priority. Skip unless forced into Timebreaker comp.

Crest.effect: Timebreaker emblem.
Crest.decision_note: Only relevant for Timebreaker vertical which is C tier. Pass.
Crest.pivot_threshold: Do not take unless Timebreakers is your comp.

Crown.effect: Timebreaker emblem + slows become roots for 1.5s.
Crown.decision_note: Roots instead of slows is a significant upgrade. Riven+Pantheon become CC machines.
Crown.pivot_threshold: Salvages Timebreaker comp to B tier. Force Timebreaker 4.

Heart.effect: +1 Primordian count. Primordian: units gain grievous wounds application on hit.
Heart.decision_note: Anti-heal embedded in trait. Strong against healing-heavy comps like Redeemer/Maokai.
Heart.pivot_threshold: Take if facing heal-heavy lobbies.

Crest.effect: Primordian emblem. Best on Bel'Veth or Rek'Sai.
Crest.decision_note: Enables Primordian 4 with Bel'Veth AS carry build.
Crest.pivot_threshold: Take if running Primordian vertical.

Crown.effect: Primordian emblem + 80% grievous wounds, Primordian units gain 15% omnivamp.
Crown.decision_note: Hard anti-heal + sustain combo. Bel'Veth becomes self-sustaining. Very strong in healing-heavy lobbies.
Crown.pivot_threshold: Force Primordian 4. Caitlyn BiS: Rageblade+GS+LW.

Heart.effect: +1 Marauder count. Marauder: units gain AS on first takedown each combat.
Heart.decision_note: AS reset on kill. Good for AS carries like Akali/Bel'Veth.
Heart.pivot_threshold: Take if Akali is on your board.

Crest.effect: Marauder emblem. Best on Kindred or Xayah for AS reset value.
Crest.decision_note: Kindred with Marauder becomes AS hypercarry. Pairs with Rageblade.
Crest.pivot_threshold: Take if Kindred or Xayah is your carry.

Crown.effect: Marauder emblem + AS reset applies on every takedown (not just first).
Crown.decision_note: Snowball AS carry. Kindred/Xayah with this Crown reaches 5+ AS in long fights.
Crown.pivot_threshold: Force AS carry build. Rageblade mandatory.

Heart.effect: +1 Challenger count. Challenger: units dash to new target after kill.
Heart.decision_note: Reset positioning carry. Kindred/Fiora become more mobile in fights.
Heart.pivot_threshold: Take if Kindred is your carry.

Crest.effect: Challenger emblem. Best on mobile carries.
Crest.decision_note: Kindred + Challenger emblem = unkitable after first kill. Strong in spread-board lobbies.
Crest.pivot_threshold: Take if Kindred/Fiora is your carry.

Crown.effect: Challenger emblem + each dash deals 150 physical damage.
Crown.decision_note: Damage on every dash. Kindred/Fiora with many targets = massive free damage. Pairs excellently with AS builds.
Crown.pivot_threshold: Force Challenger units. Keep board spread wide so dashes trigger often.

Heart.effect: +1 Dark Lady count. Dark Lady: Morgana/Vex gain stacking AP on spell hit.
Heart.decision_note: AP stacking for Vex/Morgana. Relevant in Turbo Doomer.
Heart.pivot_threshold: Take if Vex is your AP carry.

Crest.effect: Dark Lady emblem. Enables Dark Lady 4 bonus.
Crest.decision_note: Vex becomes high-stacking AP threat. Mordekaiser utility bump.
Crest.pivot_threshold: Force Dark Lady 4.

Crown.effect: Dark Lady emblem + stacks persist between rounds.
Crown.decision_note: Vex snowballs each round. Similar to Psionic Crown but for AP Doomer build.
Crown.pivot_threshold: Hard commit Doomer AP. Build JG+AA+Morello on Vex.

Heart.effect: +1 Anima count. Anima: each win generates extra Tech toward weapon upgrade.
Heart.decision_note: Faster Anima weapon tier-up. Relevant for Anima cashout comp.
Heart.pivot_threshold: Take if running Anima comp and have Illaoi.

Crest.effect: Anima emblem. +200 Tech per win.
Crest.decision_note: Tier 3 weapon achievable by stage 4. Illaoi/Aurora become massive threats earlier.
Crest.pivot_threshold: Commit Anima vertical. Tech target: 600+ by stage 4.

Crown.effect: Anima emblem + Tier 3 weapon unlocked at 400 Tech (down from 600).
Crown.decision_note: Tier 3 weapon available by 3-5. Illaoi becomes game-winning frontline by stage 4. Anima cashout becomes S-tier with this.
Crown.pivot_threshold: Hard commit Anima. Illaoi items: Sunfire+Warmog+Bramble mandatory.

double_up._note: Double Up PBE specific rules and coaching adjustments. Two players share a board and can pass units.

rules.partner_share: Overflow bench units can be donated to partner each round.
rules.unit_passing: Donated units arrive next round. Plan 1 round ahead.
rules.shared_hp: Teams share HP pool. Both boards fight simultaneously.
rules.coordination: One player builds frontline, one builds carry. Avoid contested 3-stars.
rules.augment_sharing: Augments are individual Ã¢ÂÂ not shared. Coordinate augment paths verbally.
rules.item_passing: Components and full items can be donated (not equipped items).
rules.round_sync: Both players fight simultaneously Ã¢ÂÂ board strength consistency matters more than spiking one board.

decision_priorities: Avoid contesting partner's reroll targets Ã¢ÂÂ check in before committing to a unit
Donate overflow 1-cost duplicates to partner if they are rerolling that unit
If your frontline is weak and partner has a strong tank, request a tank unit donation
Coordinate rolldown timing Ã¢ÂÂ both players ideally spike at the same round
One player takes econ augments, one takes combat augments for optimal split
Split item components across boards Ã¢ÂÂ don't double-build same component type
If partner is loss-streaking, donate your strongest tank to stabilize their HP

coordination_signals.donate_tank: Send your 2nd strongest tank if partner HP < 30
coordination_signals.donate_carry: Send overflow carry duplicates to help partner 3-star
coordination_signals.coordinate_rolldown: Signal partner before rolling to avoid sharing pool at same time
coordination_signals.augment_split: Partner takes econ aug if you take combat aug and vice versa
coordination_signals.item_split: Avoid both building BF Sword items Ã¢ÂÂ split AD/AP item paths

pbe_notes.instability: PBE server may DC mid-game. Ops protocol: relaunch via LCU auto-accept. Monitor health.json.

Dark Star Vertical.gameplan: TWO-STAGE carry plan. Stage 1: Kai'Sa 3★ carry. Stage 2: Karma upgrade. EARLY: Reroll at 3-2 on 50g+ for Cho 3★ + Lissandra 3★. Fill frontline with Maokai. MID: After 3-stars hit, level to 5 → slot Kai'Sa + Vex for DS4. Give Rageblade + Giant Slayer to Kai'Sa immediately - she IS your carry now. Level 6 at 3-5/4-1 → add Morgana (DS5 + Fateweaver 3 = shop roll bonus). OPTIONAL: If Kai'Sa is at 2+ copies at Lv6, slow-roll for Kai'Sa 3★ before pushing to Lv7. Level 7 at 4-2 → add Shen (DS still 5 or 6 if Karma in hand). Level 8 ONLY when Karma 2★ is in shop or bench - slot her and give JG/Rabadon. DS6 Karma Supermassive is the power ceiling but NOT required. Kai'Sa 3★ + DS5 + Fateweaver 3 wins fights on its own through Stage 5.

rolldown.4-1: Secondary roll if 3-stars not hit yet. Do NOT level 6 until Cho + Liss locked.

rolldown.lv8: Push lv8 ONLY when Karma 2★ is available. Roll for Karma 2★ here.
rolldown.lv9: Only if healthy HP (45+) and Jhin available. Not mandatory.

level_ups.4-1 optional: Slow-roll lv6 if Kai'Sa at 2 copies
level_ups.5-3+: Level 9 if 70g+ and healthy - Jhin cap

Dark Star Vertical.heuristic_note: Kai'Sa 3★ is the MID-GAME CARRY. Give her Rageblade + Giant Slayer at stage 3-4. DS5 + Fateweaver 3 (Liss + Vex + Morgana) is the stable mid-game board. Karma is an UPGRADE at Lv8, not a requirement. Vex and Morgana are interchangeable - both are DS + Fateweaver. Do NOT leave items on bench waiting for Karma - Kai'Sa uses them productively until then. Top-4 path: Cho3 + Liss3 + KaiSa3 rerolled, DS5 + FW3 stable board. Top-1 path: same + Karma 2★ at Lv8 for DS6 Supermassive.
Dark Star Vertical.board_notes: Kai'Sa row 2 col 6 - protected but in auto range, AS carry position. Karma D3 back-center - Supermassive covers full board at DS6. Jhin D6 far corner - 4th shot burst. Cho'Gath A1 front-left - HP snowball anchor. Shen A4 + Aatrox A6 - DS frontline wall with Darkin.
